<!--
Figure 3   Simulated incidence counts by group, body site and scenario
Figure 4   Acquisition counts by event type, by group and scenario
eFigure 8  Simulated vs observed contamination (violin)
eFigure 9  Per-group Sobol' first-order / total-effect indices
eFigure 10 Hourly contamination prevalence, 8 h shift (both scenarios)
eFigure 11 Hourly contamination prevalence, 12 h shift (both scenarios)

REQUIREMENTS
------------
* Section 1 reads the raw REDCap CSV exports via the setwd() path inside that
chunk — edit that path to your data folder (or set RUN_DATA_PREP <- FALSE to
skip it; the figure chunks do not depend on it, they load the caches).
* The RDS caches (all_sims, all_sims_cl, all_preds, contamination_data,
p1_combined_res, efig10_11_prevalence) must be present in CACHE_DIR if starting
skipping simulation runs.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(binom)

## ---- paths (EDIT THESE FOR YOUR MACHINE) ---------------------------------
PROJECT_ROOT <- "S:/EXTEND-PPE-Study-main"      # repo root
CACHE_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT)       # where the *.RDS caches live
FIG_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "figures")      # where TIFF figures are written
dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

RUN_DATA_PREP   <- TRUE    # set FALSE to skip Section 1 (figures still work from caches)
RUN_SIMULATIONS <- FALSE    # set TRUE to regenerate all_sims/all_preds/summ* from `pars`
#   (pure-R engine; ~tens of minutes for 4x1000 reps + extend).
#   Default FALSE -> figures load the cached objects instead.
```

## 0. Helper functions

Legality / toggle helpers used by the Data Preparation section.

```{r helpers}
# Toggle legality from current config (neutral always legal)
.default_items <- c("mask","glove","gown","eyeprot")
hh_actions <- c("handhygiene_foam","handhygiene_soap")
neutral_actions <- c("handhygiene_foam","handhygiene_soap","env_touch")

# update on/off config given an action like "mask_on"/"mask_off"
apply_toggle <- function(cfg, action) {
  if (!is.character(action) || is.na(action)) return(cfg)
  if (action %in% neutral_actions) return(cfg)
  if (!grepl("_", action, fixed = TRUE)) return(cfg)
  sp <- strsplit(action, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  item <- sp[1]; st <- sp[2]
  if (!(item %in% names(cfg))) return(cfg)
  if (st %in% c("on","off")) cfg[[item]] <- st
  cfg
}

# is this action legal under config?
is_legal <- function(cfg, action) {
  if (is.na(action) || !nzchar(action)) return(FALSE)
  if (action %in% neutral_actions) {
    if (action == "env_touch") return(TRUE)
    item <- "glove"
    cur <- if (item %in% names(cfg)) cfg[[item]] else "off"
    return(cur == "off")
  } 
  if (!grepl("_", action, fixed = TRUE)) return(FALSE)
  sp <- strsplit(action, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(sp) < 2) return(FALSE)
  item <- sp[1]; st <- sp[2]
  cur <- if (item %in% names(cfg)) cfg[[item]] else "off"
  if (st == "on")  return(cur == "off")
  if (st == "off") return(cur == "on")
  FALSE
}

# sample with probabilities; returns NA if nothing to choose
.sample_with_probs <- function(vals, probs) {
  if (length(vals) == 0L) return(NA_character_)
  probs <- probs / sum(probs)
  vals[sample.int(length(vals), 1L, prob = probs)]
}
```

## A. Simulation engine  *(runs only when `RUN_SIMULATIONS = TRUE`)*

Defines the contamination engine — `compute_composite_states`
(Scenario 1) and `compute_composite_states_env` (Scenario 2, environmental start).

```{r sim_engine, eval=RUN_SIMULATIONS}
library(future.apply)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
if (!exists("events_dt2")) events_dt2 <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "events_dt2.RDS"))
compute_composite_states <- function(events_dt2, 
                                     items = c('mask','glove','gown','eyeprot'),
                                     ppecontam_prob = 0.75, 
                                     selfcontam_prob = 0.6,
                                     cross_contam_prob = 0.65,
                                     hh_prob = 0.8,
                                     # configurable initial contamination
                                     init_mask_contam   = TRUE,
                                     init_eyeprot_contam= TRUE,
                                     init_glove_contam  = FALSE,
                                     init_gown_contam   = FALSE,
                                     # time-based decay rate per minute
                                     transfer_rate = 0.026,   # e.g., 0.05 = 5% chance/min
                                     all_clean_start = FALSE) {
  events_dt <- copy(events_dt2)
  
  # Define cohort-specific behaviors
  cohort_behaviors <- list(
    # Cohort 1: Single use PPE – Facemask
    "1" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 2: Single use PPE – N95  
    "2" = list(
      mask_type = "n95",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 3: Extended PPE use WITH re-use – Facemask
    "3" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = TRUE,
      eyeprot_reuse = TRUE
    ),
    # Cohort 4: Extended PPE use WITH re-use – N95
    "4" = list(
      mask_type = "n95", 
      mask_reuse = TRUE,
      eyeprot_reuse = TRUE
    ),
    # Cohort 5: Extended PPE use WITHOUT re-use – Facemask
    "5" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 6: Extended PPE use WITHOUT re-use – N95
    "6" = list(
      mask_type = "n95",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  events_dt[, c("composite_state", 
                "mask_contam", "eyeprot_contam", "glove_contam", "gown_contam",
                "hands_contam", "wrist_contam", "face_contam", "body_contam") := {
                  
                  # Get cohort behavior for this record
                  cohort_id <- as.character(cohort[1])
                  behavior <- cohort_behaviors[[cohort_id]]
                  
                  # Initial state: all off, all clean unless overridden
                  config <- setNames(rep("off", length(items)), items)
                  
                  # Flag for first donning event
                  mask_init <- TRUE
                  eyeprot_init <- TRUE
                  glove_init <- TRUE
                  gown_init <- TRUE
                  
                  mask_reused <- FALSE
                  eyeprot_reused <- FALSE
                  
                  # PPE contamination states - initial contamination depends on args
                  mask_contam   <- if (!all_clean_start && init_mask_contam)   "contaminated" else "clean"
                  eyeprot_contam<- if (!all_clean_start && init_eyeprot_contam)"contaminated" else "clean"
                  glove_contam  <- if (!all_clean_start && init_glove_contam)  "contaminated" else "clean"
                  gown_contam   <- if (!all_clean_start && init_gown_contam)   "contaminated" else "clean"
                  
                  # Self-contamination states
                  hands_contam <- "clean"
                  wrist_contam <- "clean"
                  face_contam  <- "clean"
                  body_contam  <- "clean"
                  
                  # Track previous time
                  prev_time <- Time[1]
                  
                  # Outputs
                  out_state <- character(.N)
                  out_mask_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_eyeprot_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_glove_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_gown_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_hands_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_wrist_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_face_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_body_contam <- character(.N)
                  
                  # env state
                  env_contam = "clean"
                  
                  for (i in seq_len(.N)) {
                    action <- Action[i]
                    cur_time <- Time[i]
                    
                    # === Time-dependent decay for face/body ===
                    if (i > 1) {
                      mins_passed <- as.numeric(difftime(cur_time, prev_time, units="mins"))
                      if (!is.na(mins_passed) && mins_passed > 0) {
                        transfer_prob <- min(transfer_rate * mins_passed, 1)
                        if (face_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (runif(1) < transfer_prob) {
                            face_contam <- "clean"
                          }
                        }
                        if (body_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (runif(1) < transfer_prob) {
                            body_contam <- "clean"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    if (!is.na(action) && str_detect(action, "_")) {
                      parts <- str_split(action, "_")[[1]]
                      item  <- parts[1]; state <- parts[2]
                      
                      if (item %in% items) {
                        curState <- "clean"
                        selfContamChange <- FALSE
                        if (((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") ||
                             (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated"))) {
                          selfContamChange <- TRUE
                          if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                            curState <- "contaminated"
                          }
                        }
                        config[item] <- state
                        
                        # Donning: contaminated hands can contaminate PPE
                        # All new PPE items start clean, unless reused
                        if (state == "on") {
                          if (item == "mask" && !mask_init) {
                            if (!behavior$mask_reuse) {
                              mask_contam <- curState
                            } else if (curState == "contaminated") {
                              mask_contam <- curState   # reuse: accumulate hand->mask transfer (matches C++ / _env)
                            }
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              face_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "eyeprot" && !eyeprot_init) {
                            if (!behavior$eyeprot_reuse) {
                              eyeprot_contam <- curState
                            } else if (curState == "contaminated") {
                              eyeprot_contam <- curState   # reuse: accumulate hand->eyeprot transfer
                            }
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              face_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "glove" && !glove_init) {
                            glove_contam <- curState
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              wrist_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "gown" && !gown_init) {
                            gown_contam <- curState
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              body_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                        
                        # Cohort-specific behavior for mask/eyeprot reuse
                        if (!mask_init && item == "mask" && state == "on" && mask_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (behavior$mask_reuse && mask_reused) {
                            # Reusing contaminated mask - higher contamination risk
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) { # * 1.5) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off")
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on")
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          mask_reused <- TRUE
                        }
                        
                        if (!eyeprot_init && item == "eyeprot" && state == "on" && eyeprot_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (behavior$eyeprot_reuse && eyeprot_reused) {
                            # Reusing contaminated eyeprot - higher contamination risk
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) { # * 1.5) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off")
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on")
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          eyeprot_reused <- TRUE
                        }
                        
                        # Doffing: possible self-contamination routes
                        if (state == "off") {
                          # Route 1: Direct contamination from contaminated PPE to hands/gloves
                          if (item == "mask") {
                            mask_init <- FALSE
                            # Higher risk for reused PPE
                            # risk_multiplier <- if (behavior$mask_reuse && mask_reused) 1.0 else 1.0
                            if (mask_contam == "contaminated") { # * risk_multiplier) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "eyeprot") {
                            eyeprot_init <- FALSE
                            # Higher risk for reused PPE
                            # risk_multiplier <- if (behavior$eyeprot_reuse && eyeprot_reused) 1.5 else 1.0
                            if (eyeprot_contam == "contaminated") { # * risk_multiplier) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          if (item == "glove") {
                            glove_init <- FALSE
                            if (glove_contam == "contaminated" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              wrist_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          if (item == "gown") {
                            gown_init <- FALSE
                            if (gown_contam == "contaminated") {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          # Route 2: cross-contamination chance during doffing
                          if ((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") || 
                              (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated")) {
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) {
                              if ((item == "mask" || item == "eyeprot")) {
                                face_contam <- "contaminated"
                              }
                              body_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    # Hand hygiene: resets hand/wrist contamination
                    if (!is.na(action) && action %in% c("handhygiene_foam", "handhygiene_soap") &&
                        runif(1) < hh_prob) {
                      hands_contam <- "clean"
                      wrist_contam <- "clean"
                    }
                    
                    # Env touch: contaminates PPE or hands
                    if (!is.na(action) && action == "env_touch") {
                      if ((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") || 
                          (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated")) {
                        if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                          env_contam = "contaminated"
                      } else {
                        if (env_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (config['glove'] == "on") {
                            if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                              glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          } else {
                            if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                              hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    # === Compose state string ===
                    state_str <- paste(
                      paste(paste0(names(config), ":", config), collapse = "|"),
                      paste0("mask_contam:", mask_contam),
                      paste0("eyeprot_contam:", eyeprot_contam),
                      paste0("glove_contam:", glove_contam),
                      paste0("gown_contam:", gown_contam),
                      paste0("hands_contam:", hands_contam),
                      paste0("wrist_contam:", wrist_contam),
                      paste0("face_contam:", face_contam),
                      paste0("body_contam:", body_contam),
                      sep = "|"
                    )
                    
                    out_state[i] <- state_str
                    out_mask_contam[i] <- mask_contam
                    out_eyeprot_contam[i] <- eyeprot_contam
                    out_glove_contam[i] <- glove_contam
                    out_gown_contam[i] <- gown_contam
                    out_hands_contam[i] <- hands_contam
                    out_wrist_contam[i] <- wrist_contam
                    out_face_contam[i] <- face_contam
                    out_body_contam[i] <- body_contam
                    
                    # update prev_time
                    prev_time <- cur_time
                  }
                  
                  list(out_state,
                       out_mask_contam, out_eyeprot_contam, out_glove_contam, out_gown_contam,
                       out_hands_contam, out_wrist_contam, out_face_contam, out_body_contam)
                }, by=record_id]
  
  return(events_dt)
}
events_dt2[, Time := as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%H:%M", tz = "UTC")]
events_dt <- compute_composite_states(events_dt2, init_mask_contam=TRUE, init_eyeprot_contam=TRUE)
events_dt_default <- copy(events_dt)

compute_composite_states_env <- function(events_dt2, 
                                         items = c('mask','glove','gown','eyeprot'),
                                         ppecontam_prob = pars[["p"]], 
                                         selfcontam_prob = pars[["s"]],
                                         cross_contam_prob = pars[["cross_prob"]],
                                         hh_prob = 0.8,
                                         env_prob = 0.5,
                                         # configurable initial contamination
                                         init_mask_contam   = FALSE,
                                         init_eyeprot_contam= FALSE,
                                         init_glove_contam  = FALSE,
                                         init_gown_contam   = FALSE,
                                         # time-based decay rate per minute
                                         transfer_rate = pars[["transfer_rate"]],   # e.g., 0.05 = 5% chance/min
                                         all_clean_start = TRUE) {
  events_dt <- copy(events_dt2)
  events_dt[, Time := as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")]
  
  # Define cohort-specific behaviors
  cohort_behaviors <- list(
    # Cohort 1: Single use PPE – Facemask
    "1" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 2: Single use PPE – N95  
    "2" = list(
      mask_type = "n95",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 3: Extended PPE use WITH re-use – Facemask
    "3" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = TRUE,
      eyeprot_reuse = TRUE
    ),
    # Cohort 4: Extended PPE use WITH re-use – N95
    "4" = list(
      mask_type = "n95", 
      mask_reuse = TRUE,
      eyeprot_reuse = TRUE
    ),
    # Cohort 5: Extended PPE use WITHOUT re-use – Facemask
    "5" = list(
      mask_type = "surgical",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    ),
    # Cohort 6: Extended PPE use WITHOUT re-use – N95
    "6" = list(
      mask_type = "n95",
      mask_reuse = FALSE,
      eyeprot_reuse = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  events_dt[, c("composite_state", 
                "mask_contam", "eyeprot_contam", "glove_contam", "gown_contam",
                "hands_contam", "wrist_contam", "face_contam", "body_contam") := {
                  
                  # Get cohort behavior for this record
                  cohort_id <- as.character(cohort[1])
                  behavior <- cohort_behaviors[[cohort_id]]
                  
                  # Initial state: all off, all clean unless overridden
                  config <- setNames(rep("off", length(items)), items)
                  
                  # Flag for first donning event
                  mask_init <- TRUE
                  eyeprot_init <- TRUE
                  glove_init <- TRUE
                  gown_init <- TRUE
                  
                  mask_reused <- FALSE
                  eyeprot_reused <- FALSE
                  
                  # PPE contamination states - initial contamination depends on args
                  mask_contam   <- if (!all_clean_start && init_mask_contam)   "contaminated" else "clean"
                  eyeprot_contam<- if (!all_clean_start && init_eyeprot_contam)"contaminated" else "clean"
                  glove_contam  <- if (!all_clean_start && init_glove_contam)  "contaminated" else "clean"
                  gown_contam   <- if (!all_clean_start && init_gown_contam)   "contaminated" else "clean"
                  
                  # Self-contamination states
                  hands_contam <- "clean"
                  wrist_contam <- "clean"
                  face_contam  <- "clean"
                  body_contam  <- "clean"
                  
                  # Track previous time
                  prev_time <- Time[1]
                  
                  # Outputs
                  out_state <- character(.N)
                  out_mask_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_eyeprot_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_glove_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_gown_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_hands_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_wrist_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_face_contam <- character(.N)
                  out_body_contam <- character(.N)
                  
                  # env state
                  env_contam = ifelse(runif(1) < env_prob,  "contaminated", "clean")
                  
                  for (i in seq_len(.N)) {
                    action <- Action[i]
                    cur_time <- Time[i]
                    
                    # Time-dependent decay for face/body
                    if (i > 1) {
                      mins_passed <- as.numeric(difftime(cur_time, prev_time, units="mins"))
                      if (!is.na(mins_passed) && mins_passed > 0) {
                        transfer_prob <- min(transfer_rate * mins_passed, 1)
                        if (face_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (runif(1) < transfer_prob) {
                            face_contam <- "clean"
                          }
                        }
                        if (body_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (runif(1) < transfer_prob) {
                            body_contam <- "clean"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    if (!is.na(action) && str_detect(action, "_")) {
                      parts <- str_split(action, "_")[[1]]
                      item  <- parts[1]; state <- parts[2]
                      
                      if (item %in% items) {
                        curState <- "clean"
                        selfContamChange <- FALSE
                        if (((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") ||
                             (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated"))) {
                          selfContamChange <- TRUE
                          if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                            curState <- "contaminated"
                          }
                        }
                        config[item] <- state
                        
                        # Donning: contaminated hands can contaminate PPE
                        # All new PPE items start clean, unless reused
                        if (state == "on") {
                          if (item == "mask" && !mask_init) {
                            if (!behavior$mask_reuse) {
                              mask_contam <- curState
                            } else if (curState == "contaminated") {
                              mask_contam <- curState
                            }
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              face_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "eyeprot" && !eyeprot_init) {
                            if (!behavior$eyeprot_reuse) {
                              eyeprot_contam <- curState
                            } else if (curState == "contaminated") {
                              eyeprot_contam <- curState
                            }
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              face_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "glove" && !glove_init) {
                            glove_contam <- curState
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              wrist_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "gown" && !gown_init) {
                            gown_contam <- curState
                            if (selfContamChange && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              body_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                        
                        # Cohort-specific behavior for mask/eyeprot reuse
                        if (!mask_init && item == "mask" && state == "on") {
                          if (behavior$mask_reuse && mask_reused && mask_contam == "contaminated") {
                            # Reusing contaminated mask
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off")
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on")
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          mask_reused <- TRUE
                        }
                        
                        if (!eyeprot_init && item == "eyeprot" && state == "on") {
                          if (behavior$eyeprot_reuse && eyeprot_reused && eyeprot_contam == "contaminated") {
                            # Reusing contaminated eyeprot
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off")
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on")
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          eyeprot_reused <- TRUE
                        }
                        
                        # Doffing: possible self-contamination routes
                        if (state == "off") {
                          # Route 1: Direct contamination from contaminated PPE to hands/gloves
                          if (item == "mask") {
                            mask_init <- FALSE
                            if (mask_contam == "contaminated") {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          if (item == "eyeprot") {
                            eyeprot_init <- FALSE
                            if (eyeprot_contam == "contaminated") {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          if (item == "glove") {
                            glove_init <- FALSE
                            if (glove_contam == "contaminated" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob) {
                              hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              wrist_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          if (item == "gown") {
                            gown_init <- FALSE
                            if (gown_contam == "contaminated") {
                              if (config['glove'] == "off" && runif(1) < selfcontam_prob)
                                hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                              if (config['glove'] == "on" && runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                                glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                          
                          # Route 2: cross-contamination chance during doffing
                          if ((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") || 
                              (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated")) {
                            if (runif(1) < cross_contam_prob) {
                              if ((item == "mask" || item == "eyeprot")) {
                                face_contam <- "contaminated"
                              }
                              body_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    # Hand hygiene: resets hand/wrist contamination
                    if (!is.na(action) && action %in% c("handhygiene_foam", "handhygiene_soap") &&
                        runif(1) < hh_prob) {
                      hands_contam <- "clean"
                      wrist_contam <- "clean"
                    }
                    
                    # Env touch: contaminates PPE or hands
                    if (!is.na(action) && action == "env_touch") {
                      if ((config['glove'] == "off" && hands_contam == "contaminated") || 
                          (config['glove'] == "on" && glove_contam == "contaminated")) {
                        if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob)
                          env_contam = "contaminated"
                      } else {
                        if (env_contam == "contaminated") {
                          if (config['glove'] == "on") {
                            if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                              glove_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          } else {
                            if (runif(1) < ppecontam_prob) {
                              hands_contam <- "contaminated"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    # === Compose state string ===
                    state_str <- paste(
                      paste(paste0(names(config), ":", config), collapse = "|"),
                      paste0("mask_contam:", mask_contam),
                      paste0("eyeprot_contam:", eyeprot_contam),
                      paste0("glove_contam:", glove_contam),
                      paste0("gown_contam:", gown_contam),
                      paste0("hands_contam:", hands_contam),
                      paste0("wrist_contam:", wrist_contam),
                      paste0("face_contam:", face_contam),
                      paste0("body_contam:", body_contam),
                      sep = "|"
                    )
                    
                    out_state[i] <- state_str
                    out_mask_contam[i] <- mask_contam
                    out_eyeprot_contam[i] <- eyeprot_contam
                    out_glove_contam[i] <- glove_contam
                    out_gown_contam[i] <- gown_contam
                    out_hands_contam[i] <- hands_contam
                    out_wrist_contam[i] <- wrist_contam
                    out_face_contam[i] <- face_contam
                    out_body_contam[i] <- body_contam
                    
                    # update prev_time
                    prev_time <- cur_time
                  }
                  
                  list(out_state,
                       out_mask_contam, out_eyeprot_contam, out_glove_contam, out_gown_contam,
                       out_hands_contam, out_wrist_contam, out_face_contam, out_body_contam)
                }, by=record_id]
  
  return(events_dt)
}

```

```{r sim_wrappers, eval=RUN_SIMULATIONS}
simulate_flags <- function(p, s, cross_prob, transfer_rate, dt, init_contam) {
  # Create a copy of dt to avoid modifying the original
  events_copy <- copy(dt)
  
  init_mask_contam   = FALSE
  init_eyeprot_contam= FALSE
  init_glove_contam  = FALSE
  init_gown_contam   = FALSE
  all_clean_start = FALSE
  
  if (init_contam == "none")
    all_clean_start = TRUE
  if (init_contam == "study") {
    init_mask_contam    = TRUE
    init_eyeprot_contam = TRUE
  }
  if (init_contam == "glove")
    init_glove_contam  = TRUE
  if (init_contam == "gown")
    init_gown_contam   = TRUE
  
  setDTthreads(1)
  sim_dt <- compute_composite_states(
    events_copy,
    ppecontam_prob  = p,
    selfcontam_prob = s,
    cross_contam_prob = cross_prob,
    transfer_rate = transfer_rate,
    init_mask_contam   = init_mask_contam,
    init_eyeprot_contam= init_eyeprot_contam,
    init_glove_contam  = init_glove_contam,
    init_gown_contam   = init_gown_contam,
    all_clean_start = all_clean_start
  )
  # Ensure event_min is calculated for the simulated data
  sim_dt[, event_min := hour(hms(as.ITime(Time))) * 60 + minute(hms(as.ITime(Time)))]
  
  # Handle any missing time values
  sim_dt[is.na(event_min), event_min := 0]
}

      up_to <- sub[event_min <= current_obs_min]
      if (nrow(up_to)==0) 0L

}
```

## C. Parameter calibration

The calibrated parameters were fitted once with a genetic algorithm followed by
L-BFGS-B refinement; the result is cached here as `CACHED_DIR/pars.RDS`.

Ensure the simulation section was run before this section (`RUN_SIMULATIONS=TRUE`).
Change to `eval=TRUE` in all 3 code blocks below to run the parameter estimation section (the GA is hours-long);
Section D loads the cached `pars`.

```{r calibration_parEstFunc, eval=FALSE}
create_timepoint_data <- function() {
  # Create long format data with timepoints
  timepoint_data <- melt(
    obs_timepoints,
    id.vars = c("record_id", "cohort"),
    measure.vars = patterns("^t[1-4]$"),
    value.name = "obs_time",
    variable.name = "timepoint"
  )[!is.na(obs_time)]
  
  # Define timepoint-specific contamination columns
  timepoint_cols <- list(
    t1 = c("face_fluor", "hands_fluor", "wrists_fluor",
           "f_trunk_fluor", "b_trunk_fluor",
           "f_arm_fluor", "b_arm_fluor",
           "f_leg_fluor", "b_leg_fluor"),
    t2 = grep("fluor_v2$", names(MS2_Surrogatemarker), value = TRUE),
    t3 = grep("fluor_v2_v4$", names(MS2_Surrogatemarker), value = TRUE),
    t4 = grep("fluor_v8$", names(MS2_Surrogatemarker), value = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Define body part groupings (pattern-based per timepoint)
  body_part_patterns <- list(
    hands = "hands_fluor",
    wrists = "wrists_fluor",
    face = "face_fluor",
    body = "trunk_fluor|arm_fluor|leg_fluor"
  )
  
  # Initialize result list
  result_list <- list()
  
  for (tp in names(timepoint_cols)) {
    # Get relevant contamination columns for this timepoint
    cols_tp <- timepoint_cols[[tp]]
    
    # Subset MS2_Surrogatemarker for relevant columns
    contam_subset <- MS2_Surrogatemarker[, c("record_id", "cohort", cols_tp), with = FALSE]
    
    # Create contam indicators per body part
    for (part in names(body_part_patterns)) {
      pattern <- body_part_patterns[[part]]
      matching_cols <- grep(pattern, cols_tp, value = TRUE)
      
      # If matching columns exist, create contamination indicator
      if (length(matching_cols) > 0) {
        contam_subset[, (paste0(part, "_contam")) := as.integer(rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), .SDcols = matching_cols]
      } else {
        contam_subset[, (paste0(part, "_contam")) := NA_integer_]
      }
    }
    
    # Add timepoint label
    contam_subset[, timepoint := tp]
    
    # Store in result list
    result_list[[tp]] <- contam_subset
  }
  
  # Combine all timepoint-specific contamination data
  contamination_data_tp <- rbindlist(result_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  # Merge with melted timepoint data
  timepoint_contamination <- merge(
    timepoint_data,
    contamination_data_tp,
    by = c("record_id", "cohort", "timepoint"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  
  return(timepoint_contamination)
}

# Observed counts helper
prep_obs_counts <- function(timepoint_contamination) {
  stopifnot(all(c("cohort","timepoint","obs_time") %chin% names(timepoint_contamination)))
  parts <- c("hands","wrists","face","body")
  rbindlist(lapply(parts, function(part) {
    col <- paste0(part, "_contam")
    if (!(col %chin% names(timepoint_contamination))) {
      stop(sprintf("Missing expected column '%s'", col))
    }
    timepoint_contamination[!is.na(get(col)),
                            .(
                              body_part = part,
                              k = sum(get(col) == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
                              n = sum(!is.na(get(col))),
                              mean_time = mean(obs_time, na.rm = TRUE)
                            ),
                            by = .(cohort, timepoint)
    ]
  }))
}

# Objective: binomial NLL
parameter_estimation_objective_tp <- function(params,
                                              events_dt,
                                              obs_counts,
                                              timepoint_contamination,
                                              n_sims = 1000) {
  # --- params
  ppecontam_prob    <- params[1]
  selfcontam_prob   <- params[2]
  cross_contam_prob <- params[3]
  transfer_rate     <- params[4]
  
  # --- simulate & get predicted rates by the same keys
  parts_sim_map <- list(
    hands  = "hands_contam",
    wrists = "wrist_contam",
    face   = "face_contam",
    body   = "body_contam"
  )
  
  obs_keys <- unique(timepoint_contamination[!is.na(obs_time),
                                             .(record_id, cohort, timepoint, obs_time)
  ])
  
  sim_rates_list <- future_lapply(
    X = 1:n_sims, 
    FUN = function(i) {
      setDTthreads(1)
      sim_dt <- compute_composite_states(
        events_dt,
        ppecontam_prob = params[1],
        selfcontam_prob = params[2],
        cross_contam_prob = params[3],
        transfer_rate = params[4],
        init_mask_contam = TRUE,
        init_eyeprot_contam = TRUE
      )
      
      for (part in names(parts_sim_map)) {
        col <- parts_sim_map[[part]]
        if (!col %chin% names(sim_dt)) stop(sprintf("Sim output missing '%s'", col))
        if (is.character(sim_dt[[col]]) || is.factor(sim_dt[[col]])) {
          sim_dt[, (col) := as.integer(get(col) == "contaminated")]
        } else {
          sim_dt[, (col) := as.integer(get(col))]
        }
      }
      
      sim_dt[, Time := as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%H:%M", tz = "UTC")]
      
      # Rolling nearest join by (record_id, time)
      setkey(sim_dt, record_id, Time)
      setkey(obs_keys, record_id, obs_time)
      
      sim_aligned <- sim_dt[
        obs_keys,
        on = .(record_id, Time = obs_time),
        roll = "nearest",
        nomatch = 0L
      ]
      # sim_aligned now includes i.cohort and timepoint
      
      # Compute predicted rates for each body part by (cohort, timepoint)
      sim_rates <- rbindlist(lapply(names(parts_sim_map), function(part) {
        col <- parts_sim_map[[part]]
        if (!(col %chin% names(sim_aligned))) stop(sprintf("Sim output missing '%s'", col))
        
        if (is.character(sim_aligned[[col]]) || is.factor(sim_aligned[[col]])) {
          # "contaminated"/other -> 1/0
          sim_aligned[,
                      .(predicted_rate = mean(get(col) == "contaminated", na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = .(cohort = i.cohort, timepoint = timepoint)
          ][, body_part := part]
        } else {
          # numeric/logical 0/1 (or counts) -> 0/1 via >0
          sim_aligned[,
                      .(predicted_rate = mean((as.integer(get(col)) > 0), na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = .(cohort = i.cohort, timepoint = timepoint)
          ][, body_part := part]
        }
      }), use.names = TRUE)
      
      setkey(sim_rates, cohort, body_part, timepoint)
      
      return(sim_rates)
    },
    future.seed = TRUE
  )
  
  # Average predicted rates across simulations
  pred_dt <- rbindlist(sim_rates_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)[
    , .(predicted_rate = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  ]
  setkey(pred_dt, cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  
  # Align predictions to observed cells with n>0
  fit_dt <- obs_counts[n > 0][pred_dt, on = .(cohort, body_part, timepoint)]
  
  # Fill missing predictions with cohort- or part-wise fallbacks
  if (anyNA(fit_dt$predicted_rate)) {
    # try cohort+part fallback
    fb1 <- pred_dt[, .(pred_cp = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cohort, body_part)]
    fit_dt <- fb1[fit_dt, on = .(cohort, body_part)]
    # then part-only fallback
    fb2 <- pred_dt[, .(pred_p = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)), by = body_part]
    fit_dt <- fb2[fit_dt, on = .(body_part)]
    fit_dt[is.na(predicted_rate), predicted_rate := fifelse(!is.na(pred_cp), pred_cp, pred_p)]
    fit_dt[, c("pred_cp","pred_p") := NULL]
  }
  
  # Numerical safety
  eps <- 1e-9
  fit_dt[, p := pmin(pmax(predicted_rate, eps), 1 - eps)]
  
  # Binomial NLL over (cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  nll <- -sum(fit_dt[, k*log(p) + (n - k)*log1p(-p)])
  
  return(nll)
}

parameter_estimation_tp <- function(
    events_dt,
    timepoint_contamination,
    n_sims = 1000,
    initial_params = c(ppecontam_prob = 0.741, selfcontam_prob = 0.613, cross_contam_prob = 0.112, transfer_rate = 0.0063)
) {
  
  # Prepare observed counts
  obs_counts <- prep_obs_counts(timepoint_contamination)
  setkey(obs_counts, cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  
  # Future call in objective function
  plan(multisession, workers = availableCores() - 1)
  
  # Define the objective function for the optimizer
  objective_func <- function(params) {
    # Numerical safety for probabilities
    params <- pmin(pmax(params, 1e-9), 1 - 1e-9)
    
    # Use the parameter_estimation_objective_tp function with the new parameter
    loss <- parameter_estimation_objective_tp(
      params = params,
      events_dt = events_dt,
      obs_counts = obs_counts,
      timepoint_contamination = timepoint_contamination,
      n_sims = n_sims
    )
    return(loss)
  }
  
  # Set lower and upper bounds for the parameters
  lower_bounds <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  upper_bounds <- c(1, 1, 1, 1)
  
  # Run the optimizer
  cat("Starting optimization...\n")
  optimization_result <- optim(
    par = initial_params,
    fn = objective_func,
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = lower_bounds,
    upper = upper_bounds,
    control = list(trace = 1, factr = 1e5)
  )
  
  # Store results
  estimated_params <- optimization_result$par
  names(estimated_params) <- names(initial_params)
  
  # Return the results
  return(list(
    best_params = estimated_params,
    best_loss = optimization_result$value,
    convergence_details = optimization_result
  ))
}
```

```{r calibration_GA, eval=FALSE}
parameter_estimation_objective_seq <- function(params,
                                               events_dt,
                                               obs_counts,
                                               obs_keys,
                                               n_sims = 1000) {
  # --- params
  ppecontam_prob    <- params[1]
  selfcontam_prob   <- params[2]
  cross_contam_prob <- params[3]
  transfer_rate     <- params[4]
  
  # --- simulate & get predicted rates by the same keys
  parts_sim_map <- list(
    hands  = "hands_contam",
    wrists = "wrist_contam",   # make sure this matches your sim output
    face   = "face_contam",
    body   = "body_contam"
  )
  
  sim_rates_list <- lapply(
    X = 1:n_sims, 
    FUN = function(i) {
      sim_dt <- compute_composite_states(
        events_dt,
        ppecontam_prob = params[1],
        selfcontam_prob = params[2],
        cross_contam_prob = params[3],
        transfer_rate = params[4],
        init_mask_contam = TRUE,
        init_eyeprot_contam = TRUE
      )
      
      for (part in names(parts_sim_map)) {
        col <- parts_sim_map[[part]]
        if (!col %chin% names(sim_dt)) stop(sprintf("Sim output missing '%s'", col))
        if (is.character(sim_dt[[col]]) || is.factor(sim_dt[[col]])) {
          sim_dt[, (col) := as.integer(get(col) == "contaminated")]
        } else {
          sim_dt[, (col) := as.integer(get(col))]
        }
      }
      sim_dt[, Time := as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%H:%M", tz = "UTC")]
      
      # Rolling nearest join by (record_id, time)
      setkey(sim_dt, record_id, Time)
      setkey(obs_keys, record_id, obs_time)
      
      sim_aligned <- sim_dt[
        obs_keys,
        on = .(record_id, Time = obs_time),
        roll = "nearest",
        nomatch = 0L
      ]
      # sim_aligned now includes i.cohort and timepoint
      
      # Compute predicted rates for each body part by (cohort, timepoint)
      sim_rates <- rbindlist(lapply(names(parts_sim_map), function(part) {
        col <- parts_sim_map[[part]]
        if (!(col %chin% names(sim_aligned))) stop(sprintf("Sim output missing '%s'", col))
        
        if (is.character(sim_aligned[[col]]) || is.factor(sim_aligned[[col]])) {
          # "contaminated"/other -> 1/0
          sim_aligned[,
                      .(predicted_rate = mean(get(col) == "contaminated", na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = .(cohort = i.cohort, timepoint = timepoint)
          ][, body_part := part]
        } else {
          # numeric/logical 0/1 (or counts) -> 0/1 via >0
          sim_aligned[,
                      .(predicted_rate = mean((as.integer(get(col)) > 0), na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = .(cohort = i.cohort, timepoint = timepoint)
          ][, body_part := part]
        }
      }), use.names = TRUE)
      
      setkey(sim_rates, cohort, body_part, timepoint)
      
      return(sim_rates)
    }
  )
  
  # Average predicted rates across simulations
  pred_dt <- rbindlist(sim_rates_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)[
    , .(predicted_rate = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  ]
  setkey(pred_dt, cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  
  # Align predictions to observed cells with n>0
  fit_dt <- obs_counts[n > 0][pred_dt, on = .(cohort, body_part, timepoint)]
  
  # Fill missing predictions with cohort- or part-wise fallbacks
  if (anyNA(fit_dt$predicted_rate)) {
    # try cohort+part fallback
    fb1 <- pred_dt[, .(pred_cp = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cohort, body_part)]
    fit_dt <- fb1[fit_dt, on = .(cohort, body_part)]
    # then part-only fallback
    fb2 <- pred_dt[, .(pred_p = mean(predicted_rate, na.rm = TRUE)), by = body_part]
    fit_dt <- fb2[fit_dt, on = .(body_part)]
    fit_dt[is.na(predicted_rate), predicted_rate := fifelse(!is.na(pred_cp), pred_cp, pred_p)]
    fit_dt[, c("pred_cp","pred_p") := NULL]
  }
  
  # Numerical safety
  eps <- 1e-9
  fit_dt[, p := pmin(pmax(predicted_rate, eps), 1 - eps)]
  
  # Binomial NLL over (cohort, body_part, timepoint)
  nll <- -sum(fit_dt[, k*log(p) + (n - k)*log1p(-p)])
  
  return(nll)
}

fitness_function <- function(params) {
  # Numerical safety for probabilities
  params <- pmin(pmax(params, 1e-9), 1 - 1e-9)
  
  # Use the parameter_estimation_objective_tp function with the new parameter
  loss <- parameter_estimation_objective_seq(
    params = params,
    events_dt = events_dt,
    obs_counts = obs_counts,
    obs_keys = obs_keys,
    n_sims = n_sims_ga
  )
  return(-loss)
}
```

## E. Extend to 8 & 12 h shifts  *(runs only when `RUN_SIMULATIONS = TRUE`)*

Tiles each shift out to 8 h and 12 h with the fitted action kernels, re-simulates,
and summarises hourly prevalence → `summ8`/`summ12` (Scenario 1) and
`summ8CL`/`summ12CL` (Scenario 2). These feed eFigures 10 & 11.

```{r sim_extend, eval=RUN_SIMULATIONS}
# Fit k=1 kernels per cohort: P(next | prev), plus neutral per-hour rates
fit_action_kernels <- function(dt, items = .default_items) {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  stopifnot(all(c("record_id","cohort","Time","Action") %chin% names(dt)))
  setorder(dt, record_id, Time, na.last = TRUE)
  # prev action within record
  dt[, prev := shift(Action), by = record_id]
  # transitions per cohort
  trans <- dt[!is.na(prev) & !is.na(Action), .N, by = .(cohort, prev, nxt = Action)]
  trans[, p := (N + 1) / (sum(N) + .N), by = .(cohort, prev)]  # Laplace smoothing
  
  dt[, hour := as.POSIXct(format(Time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00"), tz = "UTC")]
  
  all_coh <- unique(dt$cohort)
  
  # Overall per-hour neutral (HH + env-touch) rate — used by extend_with_kernels_tiled
  neu        <- dt[Action %in% neutral_actions, .N, by = .(record_id, cohort, hour)]
  neu_per_hr <- neu[, .(neutral_per_hr = mean(N)), by = .(record_id, cohort)]
  rates      <- neu_per_hr[, .(neutral_per_hr = mean(neutral_per_hr)), by = cohort]
  rates      <- merge(data.table(cohort = all_coh), rates, all.x = TRUE)
  rates[is.na(neutral_per_hr), neutral_per_hr := 1]
  
  # Overall action rate per record (used to preserve rate when tiling)
  hourly_rates <- dt[, .(actions_per_hour = .N / as.numeric(difftime(max(Time), min(Time),
                                                                     units = "hours"))),
                     by = .(record_id, cohort)]
  
  list(transitions   = trans,
       neutral_rates = rates,
       items         = items,
       hourly_rates  = hourly_rates)
}

##### hybrid extension: tiling + kernel mutations with neutral caps
parse_sequence_col <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) return(character())
  if (is.list(x)) {
    v <- x[[1L]]
    if (is.null(v) || all(is.na(v))) return(character())
    return(as.character(v))
  }
  if (length(x) > 1L) return(as.character(x))
  s <- as.character(x[1L])
  if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return(character())
  v <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(s, "[,]+")))
  v[nzchar(v)]
}
parse_doffing <- parse_sequence_col   # top-level alias

append_end_doffing <- function(cfg, rec_horizon, doff_gap_secs, doff_spacing_secs,
                               doffing_seq_raw, items, record_id, coh, n_start_sort) {
  t_doff_start <- rec_horizon - as.difftime(doff_gap_secs, units = "secs")
  
  # Attempt 1: use observed doffing sequence, filtered to currently-ON items
  doff_raw   <- parse_doffing(doffing_seq_raw)
  doff_legal <- character()
  cfg_tmp    <- cfg
  for (a in doff_raw) {
    if (is_legal(cfg_tmp, a)) {
      doff_legal <- c(doff_legal, a)
      cfg_tmp    <- apply_toggle(cfg_tmp, a)
    }
  }
  
  # Attempt 2: synthetic doffing in reverse-donning order for items still ON
  if (length(doff_legal) == 0L) {
    still_on   <- names(cfg)[vapply(names(cfg), function(it) cfg[[it]] == "on", logical(1))]
    candidates <- paste0(rev(still_on), "_off")
    doff_legal <- candidates[vapply(candidates, function(a) is_legal(cfg, a), logical(1))]
  }
  
  if (length(doff_legal) == 0L) return(list())
  
  lapply(seq_along(doff_legal), function(k) {
    list(record_id  = record_id,
         cohort     = coh,
         Time       = t_doff_start + as.difftime((k - 1L) * doff_spacing_secs, units = "secs"),
         Action     = doff_legal[k],
         PPE        = sub("_(?!.*_).*", "", doff_legal[k], perl = TRUE),
         sort_order = n_start_sort + k)
  })
}

extend_with_kernels_tiled <- function(events_dt2,
                                      horizon_hours = NULL,
                                      horizon_factor = 2,
                                      kernels = NULL,
                                      items = .default_items,
                                      mutate_prob = 0.35,
                                      neutral_cap_mult = 1.1,
                                      doff_gap_secs = 300L,
                                      doff_spacing_secs = 30L,
                                      seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  dt0 <- copy(events_dt2)
  stopifnot(all(c("record_id","cohort","Time","Action") %chin% names(dt0)))
  setorder(dt0, record_id, Time, na.last = TRUE)
  if (!"sort_order" %chin% names(dt0)) dt0[, sort_order := seq_len(.N), by = record_id]
  if (!inherits(dt0$Time, "POSIXct")) dt0[, Time := as.POSIXct(Time, tz = "UTC")]
  
  # fit kernels if not provided
  if (is.null(kernels)) kernels <- fit_action_kernels(dt0, items = items)
  trans <- kernels$transitions
  neutral_rates <- kernels$neutral_rates
  hourly_rates <- kernels$hourly_rates
  
  # function to mutate a templated action
  mutate_action <- function(cohort, prev_action, cfg, templated_action,
                            tstamp, neu_budget_left) {
    # with probability mutate_prob, try kernel; else keep template
    if (runif(1) >= mutate_prob) return(list(act = templated_action, used_neu = 0L))
    
    cand <- trans[cohort == cohort & prev == prev_action]
    if (!nrow(cand)) return(list(act = templated_action, used_neu = 0L))
    
    # legality filter
    cand[, legal := vapply(nxt, function(a) is_legal(cfg, a), logical(1))]
    cand <- cand[legal == TRUE]
    if (!nrow(cand)) return(list(act = templated_action, used_neu = 0L))
    
    # if neutral budget is gone, zero their probs
    if (neu_budget_left <= 0) {
      cand[, p := ifelse(nxt %in% neutral_actions, 0, p)]
      cand <- cand[p > 0]
      if (!nrow(cand)) return(list(act = templated_action, used_neu = 0L))
    }
    
    # renormalize and sample
    cand[, p := p / sum(p)]
    proposed <- .sample_with_probs(cand$nxt, cand$p)
    
    # respect budget
    used_neu <- as.integer(proposed %in% neutral_actions)
    if (used_neu == 1L && neu_budget_left <= 0) {
      # fall back to non-neutral if possible
      nn <- cand[!(nxt %in% neutral_actions)]
      if (nrow(nn)) {
        proposed <- .sample_with_probs(nn$nxt, nn$p / sum(nn$p))
        used_neu <- 0L
      } else {
        proposed <- templated_action
        used_neu <- 0L
      }
    }
    list(act = proposed, used_neu = used_neu)
  }
  
  # Extension logic (preserves action rate)
  ext_all <- dt0[, {
    n <- .N
    if (n < 2L) {
      data.table()
    } else {
      # prepare tiling template
      dsec <- as.numeric(diff(Time), units = "secs")
      tpl <- data.table(dsec = dsec,
                        Action = Action[-1L],
                        PPE    = if ("PPE" %chin% names(.SD)) PPE[-1L] else NA_character_)
      t_start <- Time[1L]; t_last <- Time[n]
      span_hrs <- as.numeric(difftime(t_last, t_start, units = "hours"))
      # Calculate target actions based on original rate
      recID <- record_id[1L]
      orig_rate <- hourly_rates[record_id == recID, actions_per_hour]
      
      target_duration_hrs <- if (!is.null(horizon_hours)) {
        horizon_hours
      } else {
        span_hrs * horizon_factor
      } 
      target_actions <- round(orig_rate * target_duration_hrs) - n
      
      rec_horizon <- if (!is.null(horizon_hours)) {
        t_start + as.difftime(horizon_hours, units = "hours")
      } else {
        t_start + as.difftime(span_hrs * horizon_factor, units = "hours")
      }
      if (t_last >= rec_horizon) {
        data.table()
      } else {
        # initialize config by replaying observed actions
        cfg <- setNames(rep("off", length(items)), items)
        for (a in Action) cfg <- apply_toggle(cfg, a)
        prev_action <- Action[n]
        
        # neutral budget per hour from cohort stats
        coh <- cohort[1L]
        obs_rate <- neutral_rates[cohort == coh, neutral_per_hr]
        cap_per_hour <- neutral_cap_mult * (if (length(obs_rate)) obs_rate else 1)
        # counters keyed by hour bucket
        neu_used <- integer()
        names(neu_used) <- character()
        
        cur_time <- t_last
        next_sort <- sort_order[n]
        idx <- 1L
        out <- vector("list", 0L)
        
        # Track actual actions generated to match rate
        actual_actions <- 0
        
        while (cur_time < rec_horizon - as.difftime(doff_gap_secs, units = "secs")) {
          gap <- tpl$dsec[idx]
          if (is.finite(gap) && gap >= 0) {
            cur_time <- cur_time + gap
            next_sort <- next_sort + 1L
            
            templated <- tpl$Action[idx]
            
            # get current hour bucket and remaining budget
            hr_key <- format(as.POSIXct(cur_time, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
                             "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00")
            if (!(hr_key %in% names(neu_used))) neu_used[hr_key] <- 0L
            neu_left <- as.integer(max(0, floor(cap_per_hour) - neu_used[hr_key]))
            
            # Check if we've exceeded target actions (optional safety)
            if (!is.null(target_actions) && actual_actions >= target_actions) {
              break  # Stop extending if target reached
            }
            
            # ensure template is legal; if not, try to repair via kernel
            chosen <- templated
            used_neu <- 0L
            if (!is_legal(cfg, templated)) {
              mut <- mutate_action(coh, prev_action, cfg, templated, cur_time, neu_left)
              chosen <- mut$act; used_neu <- mut$used_neu
              # if still illegal, try a deterministic legal fallback (toggle the first possible)
              if (!is_legal(cfg, chosen)) {
                # try same-item opposite toggle first (e.g. mask_on→mask_off at cycle wrap)
                sp <- strsplit(templated, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
                if (length(sp) >= 2L) {
                  opp_state  <- if (sp[2L] == "on") "off" else "on"
                  opp_action <- paste0(sp[1L], "_", opp_state)
                  if (is_legal(cfg, opp_action)) {
                    chosen <- opp_action
                  } else {
                    legal_toggles <- unlist(lapply(items, function(it) {
                      if (cfg[[it]] == "off") paste0(it, "_on") else paste0(it, "_off")
                    }), use.names = FALSE)
                    pref <- intersect(c("glove_on", "glove_off"), legal_toggles)
                    if (!length(pref)) pref <- legal_toggles
                    if (length(pref)) chosen <- pref[1L]
                  }
                }
              }
            } else {
              # maybe mutate (respecting budget)
              mut <- mutate_action(coh, prev_action, cfg, templated, cur_time, neu_left)
              chosen <- mut$act; used_neu <- mut$used_neu
            }
            
            # update budget & state
            if (chosen %in% neutral_actions) neu_used[hr_key] <- neu_used[hr_key] + used_neu
            cfg <- apply_toggle(cfg, chosen)
            prev_action <- chosen
            
            out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- list(
              record_id = record_id[1L],
              cohort    = coh,
              Time      = cur_time,
              Action    = chosen,
              PPE       = if ("PPE" %chin% names(.SD)) tpl$PPE[idx] else NA_character_,
              sort_order= next_sort
            )
            # Update action counter
            actual_actions <- actual_actions + 1
          }
          idx <- if (idx < nrow(tpl)) idx + 1L else 1L
        }
        doff_events <- append_end_doffing(
          cfg               = cfg,
          rec_horizon       = rec_horizon,
          doff_gap_secs     = doff_gap_secs,
          doff_spacing_secs = doff_spacing_secs,
          doffing_seq_raw   = if ("doffing_sequence" %chin% names(dt0)) doffing_sequence[1L] else NA_character_,
          items             = items,
          record_id         = record_id[1L],
          coh               = coh,
          n_start_sort      = next_sort
        )
        out <- c(out, doff_events)
        
        if (length(out)) rbindlist(out) else data.table()
      }
    }
  }, by = record_id]
  
  ans <- rbindlist(list(dt0, ext_all), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  setorder(ans, record_id, Time, sort_order)
  ans[]
}

# ---- convenience wrapper: learn + extend in one call -----------------------
extend_by_tiling_with_kernels <- function(events_dt2,
                                          horizon_hours = NULL,
                                          horizon_factor = 2,
                                          items = .default_items,
                                          mutate_prob = 0.35,
                                          neutral_cap_mult = 1.1,
                                          doff_gap_secs = 300L,
                                          doff_spacing_secs = 30L,
                                          seed = NULL) {
  k <- fit_action_kernels(events_dt2, items = items)
  extend_with_kernels_tiled(events_dt2,
                            horizon_hours = horizon_hours,
                            horizon_factor = horizon_factor,
                            kernels = k,
                            items = items,
                            mutate_prob = mutate_prob,
                            neutral_cap_mult = neutral_cap_mult,
                            doff_gap_secs = doff_gap_secs,
                            doff_spacing_secs = doff_spacing_secs,
                            seed = seed)
}
ensure_sorted <- function(dt) {
  cols <- intersect(c("record_id", "Time", "sort_order"), names(dt))
  if (length(cols)) setorderv(dt, cols)
  dt
}

### Get hourly prevalence
snapshot_prevalence_by_hour_multi <- function(dt_ccs,
                                              metrics = c("hands_contam","wrist_contam","face_contam","body_contam"),
                                              time_col   = "Time",
                                              cohort_col = "cohort",
                                              record_col = "record_id",
                                              min_coverage = 0.1) {
  stopifnot(all(c(cohort_col, record_col, time_col, metrics) %in% names(dt_ccs)))
  DT <- copy(dt_ccs[, c(cohort_col, record_col, time_col, metrics), with = FALSE])
  DT[, h := as.numeric(difftime(Time, min(Time), units = "hours")), by = .(record_id, cohort)]
  
  # long format: one row per metric
  long <- melt(
    DT,
    id.vars = c("cohort","record_id","h"),
    measure.vars = metrics,
    variable.name = "metric",
    value.name = "status"
  )
  
  # contamination indicator
  long[, contam := fifelse(status == "contaminated", 1L, 0L, NA_integer_)]
  
  # span per (cohort, record, metric)
  span <- long[, .(h_min = min(h, na.rm = TRUE), h_max = max(h, na.rm = TRUE)),
               by = .(cohort, record_id, metric)]
  grid <- span[, .(h = seq(h_min, ceiling(h_max))), by = .(cohort, record_id, metric)]
  
  setkey(long, cohort, record_id, metric, h)
  setkey(grid, cohort, record_id, metric, h)
  
  # non-equi rolling join for LOCF
  snap <- long[grid, on = .(cohort, record_id, metric, h), roll = TRUE][
    , .(cohort, record_id, metric, h, contam)]
  
  # coverage filter per (cohort, metric, hour)
  cov_by_hour <- snap[, .(n = .N, n_nonNA = sum(!is.na(contam))), by = .(cohort, metric, h)]
  cov_by_hour[, coverage := n_nonNA / n]
  keep <- cov_by_hour[coverage >= min_coverage, .(cohort, metric, h)]
  snap <- snap[keep, on = .(cohort, metric, h)]
  
  # cohort-level prevalence
  out <- snap[, .(p_contam = mean(contam, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cohort, metric, h)]
  setorder(out, cohort, metric, h)
  out[]
}
```

```{r load_cache}
## shared colour + cohort-renumbering helpers ------------------------------
# manuscript group numbering: study cohorts 3/4 (reuse) -> groups 5/6,
# study cohorts 5/6 -> groups 3/4; 1/2 unchanged.
remap_cohort <- function(dt) {
  dt[, cohort_new := fcase(cohort == 3, 5, cohort == 4, 6,
                           cohort == 5, 3, cohort == 6, 4,
                           default = as.double(as.character(cohort)))]
  dt[, cohort_new := factor(as.integer(cohort_new))]
  dt
}

if (!exists("norm_status"))
  norm_status <- function(x) fifelse(as.character(x) %in% c("1","contaminated"),
                                     "contaminated", "clean")
```
