## 3. Figure 3 — Simulated incidence counts

Clean→contaminated transitions per group, body site and scenario.

```{r figure3}
incidence_counts_sim_cohort <- function(sims) {
  dt <- copy(sims); setorder(dt, record_id, run, Time)
  outs <- rbindlist(lapply(c("hands","wrist","face","body"), function(s) {
    col <- paste0(s, "_contam")
    dt[, prev := shift(get(col)), by = .(record_id, run)]
    dt[, event := (norm_status(prev) == "clean" & norm_status(get(col)) == "contaminated")]
    dt[event == TRUE, .(count = .N), by = .(cohort, run)][, site := s][]
  }))
  outs[, .(mean_count = mean(count),
           lo = quantile(count, 0.025), hi = quantile(count, 0.975)),
       by = .(cohort, site)]
}
sim_inc_combined <- rbindlist(list(
  incidence_counts_sim_cohort(all_sims)[,    type := "Scenario 1 (contaminated start)"],
  incidence_counts_sim_cohort(all_sims_cl)[, type := "Scenario 2 (clean start)"]
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
sim_inc_combined <- remap_cohort(sim_inc_combined)

fig3 <- ggplot(sim_inc_combined, aes(x = cohort_new, y = mean_count, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.25, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(site ~ .) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Scenario 1 (contaminated start)" = "#D55E00",
                               "Scenario 2 (clean start)"        = "#0072B2"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Group Number", y = "Incidence Count", title = "Simulated Incidence Counts",
       subtitle = "Bars: Mean across runs; Whiskers: 95% empirical quantiles") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")

print(fig3)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "cohort_incidence_comb.tiff"), fig3,
       width = 24, height = 18, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```

## 4. Figure 4 — Acquisition counts by event type

Mean clean→contaminated transitions per shift, attributed to the event on which
each transition occurred, pooled across body sites.

```{r figure4}
SITES <- c("hands","wrist","face","body")
classify_etype <- function(action)
  fifelse(grepl("^handhygiene", action), "hand_hygiene",
          fifelse(action == "env_touch", "env_touch", action))
ETYPE_LEVELS <- c("mask_on","mask_off","eyeprot_on","eyeprot_off",
                  "glove_on","glove_off","gown_on","gown_off","hand_hygiene","env_touch")
ETYPE_LABELS <- c(mask_on = "Mask on", mask_off = "Mask off",
                  eyeprot_on = "Eye protection on", eyeprot_off = "Eye protection off",
                  glove_on = "Glove on", glove_off = "Glove off",
                  gown_on = "Gown on", gown_off = "Gown off",
                  hand_hygiene = "Hand hygiene", env_touch = "Environmental touch")

attribution <- function(sims, scenario) {
  dt <- copy(sims); dt[, etype := classify_etype(Action)]; setorder(dt, record_id, run, Time)
  rbindlist(lapply(SITES, function(s) {
    col <- paste0(s, "_contam")
    dt[, prev := shift(get(col)), by = .(record_id, run)]
    dt[, evt  := (norm_status(prev) == "clean" & norm_status(get(col)) == "contaminated")]
    dt[evt == TRUE, .(attributed = .N), by = .(cohort, run, etype)][, site := s][]
  }))[, scenario := scenario][]
}
att <- rbindlist(list(attribution(all_sims,    "Contaminated PPE start"),
                      attribution(all_sims_cl, "Clean PPE start")))
att_j <- merge(att, att[, .(total = sum(attributed)), by = .(scenario, cohort, site, run)],
               by = c("scenario","cohort","site","run"))
att_pool_coh <- att_j[, .(attributed = sum(attributed)), by = .(scenario, cohort, site, etype)]
att_pool_coh <- remap_cohort(att_pool_coh)
att_pool_coh[, scen_short := factor(fifelse(scenario == "Contaminated PPE start", "S1", "S2"),
                                    levels = c("S1","S2"))]
n_runs    <- att_j[, .(n_runs = uniqueN(run)), by = scenario]
att_etype <- att_pool_coh[, .(attributed = sum(attributed)),
                          by = .(scenario, cohort_new, scen_short, etype)]
att_etype <- merge(att_etype, n_runs, by = "scenario")
att_etype[, mean_count := attributed / n_runs]
att_etype[, scen_lab := factor(scen_short, levels = c("S1","S2"),
                               labels = c("Scenario 1 (contaminated start)", "Scenario 2 (clean start)"))]

fig4 <- ggplot(att_etype,
               aes(x = factor(etype, levels = ETYPE_LEVELS), y = mean_count, fill = scen_lab)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort_new, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Group", x))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ETYPE_LABELS) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Scenario 1 (contaminated start)" = "#D55E00",
                               "Scenario 2 (clean start)"        = "#0072B2"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Acquisition counts by event type",
       subtitle = "Mean clean->contaminated transitions per shift, by event type and scenario (pooled across body sites)",
       x = "Event type", y = "Mean acquisitions per shift") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")

print(fig4)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "acquisition_counts_cohort.tiff"), fig4,
       width = 26, height = 18, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```

## 5. eFigure 8 — Simulated vs observed (violin)

```{r efig8_violin}
prepare_simulated_data <- function(all_preds) {
  s <- melt(all_preds, id.vars = c("record_id","cohort","timepoint","run"),
            measure.vars = c("pred_hands","pred_wrist","pred_face","pred_body"),
            variable.name = "body_part", value.name = "contamination_prob")
  s[, body_part := gsub("pred_", "", body_part)]
  s[, body_part := ifelse(body_part == "wrist", "wrists", body_part)]
  s[, data_type := "Simulated"][]
}
body_part_cols <- c("hands","wrists","face","body")
obs_counts <- rbindlist(lapply(body_part_cols, function(part_name) {
  col <- paste0(part_name, "_contam")
  contamination_data[, .(contaminated = sum(get(col) == 1, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N),
                     by = .(cohort, timepoint)][, body_part := part_name]
}), use.names = TRUE)[, probability := contaminated / n][]
ci <- binom.confint(obs_counts$contaminated, obs_counts$n, methods = "wilson")[, c("lower","upper")]
obs_counts[, `:=`(lower = ci$lower, upper = ci$upper)]

sim_summary <- prepare_simulated_data(all_preds)[
  , .(contamination_rate = mean(contamination_prob)),
  by = .(cohort, timepoint, body_part, run)]
sim_summary <- remap_cohort(sim_summary); obs_counts <- remap_cohort(obs_counts)

efig8 <- ggplot() +
  geom_violin(data = sim_summary,
              aes(x = body_part, y = contamination_rate, fill = body_part), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = obs_counts, aes(x = body_part, y = probability), color = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(data = obs_counts,
                aes(x = body_part, y = probability, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = 0.2, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_grid(timepoint ~ cohort_new) +
  labs(x = "Body Part", y = "Contamination Probability",
       title = "Simulated vs Observed (with 95% CI) by Group",
       subtitle = "Violins = simulation; red dots+bars = observed") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))

print(efig8)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "efig8_violin.tiff"), efig8,
       width = 26, height = 18, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```

## 6. eFigure 9 — Per-group Sobol' indices

```{r efig9_sobol}
cr <- as.data.table(copy(combined_res))
lab <- c(ppecontam_prob = "p[PPE]", p_ppe = "p[PPE]", pppe = "p[PPE]", p = "p[PPE]",
         selfcontam_prob = "p[Self]", p_self = "p[Self]", pself = "p[Self]", s = "p[Self]",
         cross_contam_prob = "p[cross]", p_cross = "p[cross]", pcross = "p[cross]", cross_prob = "p[cross]",
         hh_prob = "p[HH]", p_hh = "p[HH]", phh = "p[HH]",
         transfer_rate = "r[T]", r_t = "r[T]", rt = "r[T]", r_T = "r[T]", env_prob = "p[env]")
key <- tolower(as.character(cr$parameters))
cr[, plab := fifelse(key %in% names(lab), lab[key], as.character(parameters))]
ord <- c("p[PPE]","p[Self]","p[cross]","p[HH]","r[T]","p[env]")
cr[, plab := factor(plab, levels = intersect(ord, unique(plab)))]
glab <- c("1 Single-use surgical","2 Single-use N95","3 Ext. use no re-use surgical",
          "4 Ext. use no re-use N95","5 Ext. use + re-use surgical","6 Ext. use + re-use N95")
cr[, group := factor(glab[as.integer(as.character(cohort_new))], levels = glab)]
cr[, sensitivity := factor(sensitivity, levels = c("Si","Ti"),
                           labels = c("First-order (Si)", "Total-effect (Ti)"))]

efig9 <- ggplot(cr, aes(plab, original, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .72) +
  { if (all(c("low.ci","high.ci") %in% names(cr)) && is.numeric(cr$low.ci) && any(!is.na(cr$low.ci)))
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(low.ci, 0), ymax = high.ci),
                  position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .25,
                  linewidth = .3, colour = "grey30") } +
  facet_grid(sensitivity ~ metric) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text = x)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal6, name = "PPE strategy (group)") +
  labs(x = "Model parameter", y = "Sobol' sensitivity index",
       title = "Per-group Sobol' sensitivity indices") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12), strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

print(efig9)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "efig9_sobol.tiff"), efig9,
       width = 30, height = 17, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```

## 7–8. eFigures 10 & 11 — Hourly prevalence (8 h and 12 h)

```{r efig10_11_prevalence}
build_prevalence <- function(sA, sB, title) {
  all <- rbindlist(list(
    copy(sA)[, scenario := "(A) Contaminated Mask and Eye Protection"],
    copy(sB)[, scenario := "(B) Clean PPE"]))
  all <- remap_cohort(all)
  ggplot(all, aes(x = h, colour = cohort_new, fill = cohort_new)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75, group = cohort_new), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_line(aes(y = p50), linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(metric ~ scenario, switch = "x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal6) + scale_fill_manual(values = pal6) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2)) +
    labs(x = "Hour", y = "Contamination Prevalence", title = title,
         subtitle = "Bold: Median; Ribbon: IQR", color = "Group", fill = "Group") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank())
}

efig10 <- build_prevalence(summ8, summ8CL,
                           "Hourly Contamination Prevalence by Group and Metric (8 h)")
print(efig10)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "Median_IQR_8hr_combined.tiff"), efig10,
       width = 17.2, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")

efig11 <- build_prevalence(summ12, summ12CL,
                           "Hourly Contamination Prevalence by Group and Metric (12 h)")
print(efig11)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "Median_IQR_12hr_combined.tiff"), efig11,
       width = 17.2, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 1200, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```
